failures.description: is_confirmed returned state in (ACTIVE, LOST). After finalize(), all LOST tracks become ENDED. 12 of 13 genuinely confirmed person tracks reported is_confirmed=False, starving S06, S07, and narrative stages.
failures.reproduction: Run pipeline on any real footage. Count confirmed_tracks vs total person tracks post-finalize.
failures.root_cause: is_confirmed read the live state field. finalize() converts LOST->ENDED before returning TrackingResult. Tracks that were ACTIVE during processing reported False after the call. The track's confirmed_at_frame field (set at promotion time) was the correct source of truth.
failures.fix: Changed is_confirmed to return confirmed_at_frame is not None. One-line change in track.py. min_confirmation_frames was NOT changed (was never the cause).
failures.evidence: Diagnostic: 13 tracks had confirmed_at_frame != None. Only 1 (state=ACTIVE) reported is_confirmed=True before fix. After fix: all 13 report is_confirmed=True.

failures.description: AttributeError: object of type 'TrackBBox' has no len(). TrackObservation.bbox is a TrackBBox dataclass. S07 called len(bbox) and x1,y1,x2,y2=bbox treating it as a sequence. All temporal pose events suppressed silently.
failures.reproduction: Run any pipeline on real footage. Check S07 warnings: 'Temporal pose analysis failed'.
failures.root_cause: s07_event_understand.py line 405: 'if bbox is None or len(bbox) < 4'. TrackBBox is a dataclass with named fields, not a tuple or list. It has no __len__ and is not iterable.
failures.fix: Added isinstance(bbox, TrackBBox) branch that extracts x1,y1,x2,y2 from dataclass fields. Legacy tuple fallback retained for defensive completeness.
failures.evidence: S07 warning absent in after-run. 0 warnings in S07 (was 1). Temporal pose analyzer ran on 13 confirmed tracks without error.
failures.pose_events_note: Analyzer ran correctly. 0 pose events generated because 1948 pedestrian footage does not contain crawling/crouching/fallen postures that meet the geometric thresholds. This is expected honest behavior â€” NOT a continued failure.

failures.description: 0 COMPLETE story segments in all tested runs. After FAIL-006 fix, segments increased (10->15 in 60s run) but complete stories remain 0.
failures.root_cause: A COMPLETE segment requires entry+action+exit for the same confirmed track. In 60s of pedestrian footage with skip=5, confirmed tracks mostly produce entry+exit pairs without a sustained action event between them. This is a real dataset/clip-length limitation, not purely a code bug.
failures.note: FAIL-006 was identified as a contributing cause. After FAIL-006 was fixed, story segments increased (10->15) but complete stories remain 0. The failure is now understood to be primarily a clip-length and footage-type limitation, not a code defect. Not marking fixed.
